issues.description: The template repository has a method name mismatch in ArrayHelpers: ArrayHelpers.java defines appendElement (appendElement), but Stock.java calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This prevents the project from compiling and confuses students about which helper method name to use. The solution repository uses addElementToArray, indicating the intended name is addElementToArray, but the template's ArrayHelpers uses a different name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent between files. Either rename the method in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java from appendElement to addElementToArray (matching Stock.java and the solution), or update Stock.java to call ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...). Ensure the method signature and name match throughout the template so students can compile and use the helper.

issues.description: The template defines ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) but other template files (Stock.java) and the reference solution use ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This inconsistent identifier for the same helper operation will cause compilation errors in the starter code and creates unnecessary confusion for students mapping the problem guidance (which refers to ArrayHelpers) to the provided code and the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name across artifacts. Rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (or alternatively change all call sites to use appendElement). Prefer using addElementToArray(...) to match the solution and existing call sites in Stock.java so students have a consistent, compiling starter code.
